title: 第1210章 初步探查第1209章 青羽门驻地
content_zh:
长原城作为人族联盟的重要军事重镇，进出城门必然有着严格的身份核查制度。
他虽然从庞剑峰为江景宇三人准备的身份凭证的制作工艺中大致了解了灵界身份凭证的样式，但那并不意味着他就能凭空伪造出一枚能经得起城门守卫仔细核查的玉牌。
长原城或是青羽门的身份玉牌的制作需要极其精密的炼器工艺和符合联盟标准的灵材，且每一枚玉牌的发放都有备案可查。
以他目前的资源和条件，想要在短时间内无中生有地制造出一枚合法的身份玉牌，根本不现实。
贸然尝试通过城门的话，身份核查失败的后果可能是被当场扣留、盘问甚至关押，他初来灵界的这一趟隐秘偷渡就会功亏一篑。
青羽门驻地就更不用想了。
那是宗门重地，内部有大阵守护，还有镇守的炼虚修士坐镇。
所以长原城和青羽门驻地，至少在目前这个阶段，都不是他可以落脚的选项。
他需要找一个不需要严格身份核查就能进入的地方。
易长生的身形微微调整了一下方向，从面朝长原城转向了更广阔的视野范围。
他没有急着做决定，而用虚维之眼，开始对长原城周边区域进行系统的探查和摸底。
这一探查，便是三天。
第一天，他绕着长原城的外围以大约两三千里的半径做了一圈环绕探查，将城池四周的地形、势力分布和主要聚居点都大致摸了一遍。
长原城的南面和西面是两大家族的领地，从天空中可以看到大量的灵田、矿山、聚落和各式各样的建筑群，那些建筑群的规模和风格都与青羽门驻地类似但各有特色。
陈家的领地中更多见的是那种以深褐色石材建造的粗犷风格建筑，墙体厚重如堡垒。
程家的领地中则更多见以青色灵木为建材的轻巧楼阁，檐角飞翘如鸟翼。
而东面和北面则相对空旷一些。
北面是心幻平原的方向，越往北走，地面的植被就越发稀疏单调，心幻草的那种淡紫色开始逐渐出现。
东面则是庞剑峰提到的湖泽之地的方向，从天空中遥遥望去可以看到远处地平线上有一片片银白色的光斑在闪烁，那应该就是湖泽中水面反射天光形成的亮区。
那些光斑散布的范围极广，从东面天际一直延伸到视野的尽头，偶尔能看到一些光斑之间露出深绿色的岛状轮廓。

第三天中午的时候，他探到一个让他觉得有用的信息。
在长原城西南方向大约三万里处的一片区域中。
他当时正在扫描一片介于陈家领地和程家领地之间的过渡地带，那片区域的地形以低矮的丘陵和宽阔的谷地为主，地表覆盖着一种杂色的灌木和野草丛，远远看去呈现出一种黄绿相间的斑驳色调。
就在这片过渡地带的中心区域，他看到了一处规模不小的聚居点。
那是一片以灰白色建筑为主的坊市，环绕着一座不太高的翠绿色山峰建成了环形，房屋沿着山坡的走势层层排布，从山脚一直延伸到山腰。
山峰的顶部有一座格外高大的方形建筑，屋顶以一种罕见的青金色瓦片覆顶，在阳光下如同一片被点燃的青金色火焰般醒目。
那坊市的上空没有大型阵法的光芒笼罩，外围也没有城墙和岗哨，只有几面低矮的石墙和木栅栏在坊市的边缘零星分布着，与其说是防御工事，不如说是用来划定范围的地界标志。
坊市入口处没有任何守卫站岗，也没有明显的身份核查点，进出的修士身影虽然不算密集，但来来往往从未间断，从他们随意的姿态和松弛的步伐来看，进入这座坊市显然是一件并不需要经历层层盘查的事情。
易长生用虚维之眼锁仔细探查这座坊市，在他持续数个时辰的观察中，前后有数十位修士进出坊市，其中不乏一些看起来风.尘仆仆、衣着杂乱的散修。
他们进出的过程极其顺畅，没有任何人被拦截、盘问或者要求出示身份凭证。
整个坊市的氛围呈现出一种明显的“开放式”特征。
谁都可以来，谁都可以走，没有人在乎你是谁、从哪里来、要到哪里去。
这就是他需要的落脚点。
他用虚维之眼从坊市的修士交谈中，探查到了这座坊市的基本信息。
这座坊市叫做金竹坊，坐落在陈家和程家势力范围的交界地带，属于一块长年存在归属争议的地盘。
陈家和程家都曾想占领此地，但两家的势力在此处互相掣肘，谁也压不过谁，争夺了数百年都没有分出明确的结果。
就在两家长年对峙的僵局中，一位名叫张显的化神期修士趁虚而入，以与长原城联盟驻军中某位炼虚大能的私交关系作为筹码，在两家之间周旋谈判，最终以“代为镇守”的名义拿到了这片有五阶灵脉的地盘。
他在此地建立了一座坊市，自任坊主，一边在此修炼、一边管理坊市的日常运营，同时也算是替联盟驻军填补了陈家与程家之间这片防务空白地带的监视缺口。
这位张显坊主倒也精明，他深知自己夹在两大家族之间的处境微妙，因此对金竹坊采取了一种极其开放的经营策略。
不设严苛的进出盘查、不查来路背景、不问宗门出身，无论是散修、小家族子弟、甚至是一些来历不明的修士，只要不在坊市中惹事生非，都可以自由进出和停留。

这种包容的政策使得金竹坊在短短数百年间吸引了大批的散修和中小势力修士前来落脚。
坊市的规模越扩越大，从最初仅仅围绕山脚的一小片区域，逐渐发展成了覆盖整座山峰、甚至蔓延到周围丘陵地带的繁荣坊市。
易长生在心中默默地算着，金竹坊距离长原城约三万里，以梦身元婴期的飞行速度大约需要个把时辰即可到达，不算太远。
万一长原城那边有什么重要动向，他也能在相对较短的时间内做出反应。
坊市不需要身份核查即可进出，这解决了目前最大的身份难题。
content_en:
As an important military town of the Human Alliance, Changyuan City must have a strict identity verification system in and out of the city gates.
Although he had a general understanding of the style of the identity certificates in the spiritual world from the production process of the identity certificates prepared by Pang Jianfeng for Jiang Jingyu and the others, that did not mean that he could forge a jade token out of thin air that could withstand the careful inspection of the city gate guards.
The production of Changyuan City or Qingyu Sect's identity jade tokens requires extremely precise refining techniques and spiritual materials that meet alliance standards, and the issuance of each jade token is documented and traceable.
With his current resources and conditions, it is simply unrealistic to create a legal identity jade token out of thin air in a short period of time.
If he rashly tries to pass through the city gate, the consequences of failing the identity verification may be to be detained, interrogated or even imprisoned on the spot, and his secret smuggling trip to the spirit world will be in vain.
There is no need to think about the Qingyumen station.
It was an important place for the sect, and it was guarded by a large formation, and there were also Void Refining monks guarding it.
Therefore, Changyuan City and Qingyumen Station, at least at this stage, are not options for him to settle down.
He needed to find a place he could enter without strict identity checks.
Yi Changsheng adjusted his direction slightly, from facing Changyuan City to a wider field of view.
He did not rush to make a decision, but used the Eye of Virtual Dimension to begin a systematic exploration and investigation of the surrounding areas of Changyuan City.
This exploration lasted three days.
On the first day, he made a circle around the perimeter of Changyuan City with a radius of about two to three thousand miles, and roughly explored the terrain, power distribution and main settlements around the city.
The south and west of Changyuan City are the territories of the two major families. From the sky, you can see a large number of spiritual fields, mines, settlements and various building complexes. The scale and style of those building complexes are similar to the Qingyumen Station but each has its own characteristics.
The more common buildings in the Chen family's territory are rough-style buildings built with dark brown stone, with walls as thick as fortresses.
In the Cheng family's territory, there are more light pavilions made of blue spiritual wood, with eaves and corners flying like bird wings.
The east and north sides are relatively empty.
To the north is the direction of the Xinhuan Plain. The further north you go, the more sparse and monotonous the vegetation on the ground becomes, and the lavender color of the Xinhuan Grass begins to gradually appear.
To the east is the direction of the lake land mentioned by Pang Jianfeng. Looking from the sky, you can see patches of silvery white light flashing on the horizon in the distance. That should be the bright area formed by the reflection of skylight from the water surface of the lake.
Those light spots spread over a wide range, extending from the eastern skyline to the end of the field of view. Occasionally, dark green island-shaped outlines can be seen between some light spots.
At noon on the third day, he found a piece of information that he found useful.
In an area about 30,000 miles southwest of Changyuan City.
He was scanning a transitional area between the Chen family's territory and the Cheng family's territory. The terrain in that area was dominated by low hills and wide valleys. The surface was covered with variegated shrubs and weeds, which looked like a mottled yellow and green hue from a distance.
In the center of this transition zone, he saw a large settlement.
It was a city dominated by gray-white buildings, built in a ring around a not-too-high emerald green mountain peak. The houses were arranged in layers along the hillside, extending from the foot of the mountain to the mountainside.
There is an extremely tall square building on the top of the mountain. The roof is covered with a rare green-gold tile, which is as eye-catching as a ignited green-gold flame in the sun.
There is no light from a large formation in the sky above Nafang City, and there are no city walls or sentries on the periphery. There are only a few low stone walls and wooden fences scattered around the edge of Fang City. They are not so much defensive fortifications as boundary markers used to demarcate the scope.There are no guards standing guard at the entrance of the market, and there are no obvious identity verification points. Although the monks entering and exiting are not dense, they come and go continuously. Judging from their casual posture and relaxed pace, entering this market is obviously something that does not require layers of checks.
Yi Changsheng used the Eye Lock of Xuwei to carefully explore the city. During his continuous observation for several hours, he saw dozens of monks entering and leaving the city, including some casual cultivators who looked dusty and disheveled.
Their entry and exit process was extremely smooth, and no one was stopped, questioned or asked for identification.
The atmosphere of the entire city presents an obvious "open" feature.
Anyone can come, anyone can leave, no one cares who you are, where you come from, or where you are going.
This was the landing spot he needed.
He used the Eye of Xuwei to explore the basic information of this city from the conversations between the monks in the city.
This city, called Jinzhufang, is located at the junction of the spheres of influence of the Chen family and the Cheng family. It belongs to a territory that has been disputed for many years.
Both the Chen family and the Cheng family wanted to occupy this place, but the two families' forces were restrained by each other here. No one could overpower the other. They fought for hundreds of years without a clear result.
During the long-term stalemate between the two families, a monk named Zhang Xian took advantage of the situation and took advantage of the situation. Using his personal relationship with a certain Void Refining Master in the Changyuan City Alliance garrison as a bargaining chip, he negotiated between the two families and finally obtained this land with fifth-level spiritual veins in the name of "guarding on behalf of them."
He established a market here and appointed himself as the owner. While cultivating here, he managed the daily operations of the market. At the same time, he also filled the surveillance gap in the defense gap between the Chen family and the Cheng family for the alliance garrison.
The owner of Zhang Xianfang is also shrewd. He is well aware of the delicate situation in which he is caught between the two major families, so he adopts an extremely open business strategy for Jinzhufang.
There are no strict entrance and exit checks, no background checks, and no questions about sect origin. Regardless of whether they are casual cultivators, children of small families, or even some monks of unknown origin, as long as they do not cause trouble in the city, they can enter and stay freely.
This inclusive policy allowed Jinzhufang to attract a large number of casual cultivators and small and medium-sized cultivators to settle down in just a few hundred years.
The scale of the city expanded, from a small area surrounding the foot of the mountain to a prosperous city covering the entire mountain and even spreading to the surrounding hilly areas.
Yi Changsheng calculated silently in his mind that Jinzhufang was about 30,000 miles away from Changyuan City. It would take about an hour to reach it at the flight speed of the Yuan Ying stage of Meng Shen, so it was not too far.
If there is any important movement in Changyuan City, he can respond in a relatively short period of time.
Fangshi can enter and exit without identity verification, which solves the biggest identity problem at present.
